name: Shared-state head-only all-seen CE intervention
authorization: 2026-10-25 autonomous continuation after failed prespecified gain and exact-pair qualification; preserve original failure, no costly rerun
purpose: Test current-head all-seen CE while B receives only current-class CE. Add a matched current-CE control under identical numeric settings and identical saved T2 start; not a rerun of the failed FedAvg comparison.
scientific_changes: Only head loss differs within each pair. Both use FP32, TF32 off, deterministic algorithms, math SDPA, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8. These numeric settings differ from old runs; compare the new matched control, not only old historical results.
fixed_training: Original QV-r32 sharedRRS/fixedA/SSB B/FedAvg, head constrainedRegMean alpha.5, current-data only, old heads frozen, headAdamW .001 wd0 reset per client/round; B lr.0002; five rounds x five epochs batch16 per task. No rank/lr/alpha sweep.
gradient_routing: B loss uses detached classifier rows and current-class CE; head loss uses detached normalized features and current or all-seen CE. One backbone forward per minibatch; no direct cross-task gradient to B. Later B trajectories may diverge through changed heads.
shared_start: Load qualified fixed T1 checkpoint; replay T1 once under fixed new numeric mode and preserve both old/new metrics; initialize T2 RRS/head exactly once and save shared full model/state/RNG. Both arms load that exact snapshot.
qualification: Before any optimizer update, both modes must have exact augmented inputs/labels and direct B gradients, different head gradients, no old-head gradients. Each real branch rechecks its actual first batch against its preflight before first update. Existing mathematical/lifecycle tests plus new gradient-route tests must pass.

budget.clock: Use minimum actual source start and minimum source deadline, never reset original clocks. Independent supervisor enforces same limits.

evaluation: All three task matrices, raw and fixed block-centered inference on every arm; old/new/restricted/forgetting/task confusion; final checkpoint full confusion reload. Preserve source T1 metrics and all outputs. Test feedback is development evidence, no fitting or checkpoint selection.
primary_gate: Against new matched current-CE raw control: three-seed mean new-class gain >=5pp, mean old loss<=1pp, no seed old-task loss>2pp. Also report all-seen-CE raw versus matched control centered; a training gain alone cannot establish superiority to the existing centered candidate. Report the full 2x2 without choosing the best inference variant post hoc.
next: Analyze all six branches and unmodified standard LoRM references together. No automatic full10 expansion before qualification and decision.
original_failure: Both prior Head-RegMean/FedAvg exact endpoint gates remain FAILED. Synthetic within-process CUDA gradient repeats passed in all modes; unique cause of original mismatch unresolved. New shared-start design does not retrospectively qualify prior comparison.
